title: Governor reply
description: What the Governor (orchestrator) returns for one artifact: the items that belong in a register, each with evidence quotes. At runtime, code sets the allowed register names on 'register'. Code checks the reply before any work order is built from it.

items.description: One item per distinct thing that fits a register, in the order they first appear. Empty when nothing fits.

register.description: The register this item belongs to.

evidence.description: Quotes copied word for word from the artifact that point to this item; the passage that states it first.
